new.summary: Create the change folder `minispec/changes/<name>/` with the files of the tier.
flags: --tier <tier>         medium (default): proposal and tasks. big or large: also a design and a spec.
--capability <name>   the capability of the spec of a big or large change. The default is the change name.

list.summary: List the changes in progress, or the specs with --specs.

show.summary: Print the files of a change, or the spec of a capability.

status.summary: Give the task counts of a change and its next open task. With no name, use the change in progress.

validate.summary: Check a change or a spec. With no name, check each change and each spec. A check in a task must be a command.

archive.summary: Merge the spec deltas of a done change into `minispec/specs/`, and move the change to `minispec/changes/archive/`.
flags: --yes, -y   confirm the archive. The command fails without it.
